title: SessionCreatedPayload

anyOf.description: A title a user gives a session: 1 to 200 characters once trimmed; white space around it is not counted, and it is stored trimmed.

title.description: The user's title, trimmed; null for the fallback.

items.description: A free-form tag: 1 to 40 characters once trimmed, no control or format (zero-width) characters; stored trimmed, unique per session ignoring case.

tags.description: The tags, trimmed, unique ignoring case and sorted.

anyOf.description: A group's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has; the harness never makes, moves or removes it outside a workspace root.

path.description: The worktree's directory, which the environment chose and made.

repository.description: The main checkout (or bare repository) the worktree was made from.

branch.description: The branch the worktree was made on; not read again when a run switches branch.

oneOf.description: A git worktree the environment made from a repository it has.

path.description: The scratch directory, under the data directory's scratch root.

oneOf.description: A scratch directory the environment made for the session that asked for it.

anyOf.description: A workspace of a kind a later environment records: read as a directory at its path.

kind.description: A kind this version does not know.

path.description: An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

workspace.description: Where a session's code lives on its environment: a directory, a worktree or a scratch directory, each with an absolute path. A kind a client does not know reads as a directory at its path.

account.description: The account asked for, if any; the adapter workstream (#119) validates it.

model.description: The model asked for, if any; the adapter workstream (#119) validates it.

anyOf.description: What an agent may do without asking during a run, in the order ceilings use: plan < acceptEdits < auto < bypassPermissions. Claude's default and dontAsk are never used.

mode.description: The mode asked for, if any; clamped at each run, and changed by session.mode.set.

origin.description: Where the session came from when no client asked for it: import, with what the import linked and read; absent for a session a command created.

accountId.description: The adopted account whose directory holds the provider session.

providerSessionId.description: The provider's own id for the session: what the import is deduplicated by, and what a run resumes.

createdAt.description: When the provider session began, as the listing gives it: the summary's createdAt.

lastActivityAt.description: When the provider session was last written, as the listing gives it: the summary's lastActivityAt.

oneOf.description: The Carry over import made the session from a provider session in an adopted account's directory.

description: session.created: a session was created; its createdAt is the event's occurredAt, or an imported session's origin.createdAt, whose lastActivityAt is its origin's too.
